info.title: Sculpin Cognitive Ledger
info.description: Authenticated, graph-scoped API over the atomic cognitive-change workflow (ADR-0013). Mutations require a bearer token, an Idempotency-Key header and the `propose` (prepare) or `review` (accept/reject) capability; reads require `read`. Ref names may contain `/` and are therefore body/query fields. A graph that does not exist or belongs to another tenant is reported as NOT_FOUND alike. Every response carries X-Correlation-Id; every error is the Error envelope. No query language is exposed. Unknown paths and methods also answer with the Error envelope. Phase 2 (ADR-0014/0018/0019): `validate` capability requests a semantic validation of a prepared candidate (the ledger calls its configured validation service and records an immutable SemanticExecutionContext + ValidationRecord; no ref moves); accept names validation_id and semantic_environment_id and succeeds only for a conforming validation of that candidate run in that environment; reject may cite a validation.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Retries with the same key, complete actor and identical canonical request replay the original result; a different request under the same key is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Optional client correlation id; generated when absent and echoed on every response.

message.description: Safe text only; never SQL, storage paths, foreign graph or tenant identifiers.

quad.description: One canonical N-Quad; blank nodes are rejected.

expected_head.description: Current head of the ref (absent/null for genesis).

evidence_refs.description: A set: order and duplicates do not matter.

candidate.description: The v2 candidate CommitId (identity-bearing; stable across retries).

validation_id.description: Validation record acceptance is bound to; given together with semantic_environment_id.

semantic_environment_id.description: Candidate-independent semantic environment the reviewer accepts under (sculpin-semantic-environment/v1 id, as Sculpin declares it).

quads.description: Canonical N-Quads of the reconstructed state, bounded by the deployment's reconstruction and export limits.

requested.description: Context hints for the validator (all optional; part of request identity).

sources_revision.description: Sculpin external-source catalog revision the validation must run under.

BranchPolicy.description: Immutable at creation; only tightens the deployment floor (ADR-0022).

from_commit.description: Historical branch point; must be the source head or reachable from it. Omitted: the source head. Null is the same as omitted; omitted and an explicit commit are distinct request identities.

reason.description: Optional; empty or null is the same request as no reason.

strategy.description: Resolution of structurally conflicting (graph, subject, predicate) slots; `abort` (default) persists nothing when any slot conflicts. `union` is RDF set union, never a semantic judgement (ADR-0024).

base.description: Explicit merge base; must be one of the best common ancestors (required to resolve an ambiguous criss-cross history).

strategy.description: Resolution of structurally conflicting (graph, subject, predicate) slots; `abort` (default) persists nothing when any slot conflicts. `union` is RDF set union, never a semantic judgement (ADR-0024).

preview_token.description: The token of the preview the client saw; the propose recomputes it and refuses with MERGE_STALE on any difference.

message.description: Message of the integration commit (empty or null = none).

evidence_refs.description: Evidence of the integration commit (a set: sorted, de-duplicated).

validation_id.description: A conforming validation of the merge candidate (with semantic_environment_id; ADR-0019).

semantic_environment_id.description: The current semantic environment of the target.

truncated.description: More quads exist on this side than are listed (the 64-quad cap or the report byte budget).

graph.description: Named graph term; absent for the default graph.

merge_base_candidates.description: Best common ancestors of an ambiguous history, ascending.

ahead.description: Commits the source has that the target lacks.

conflict_count.description: Exact total of structurally conflicting keys; never affected by the report limits.

conflicts.description: A deterministic prefix of the conflicting keys in ascending key order: at most 1000 entries, 64 quads per side, and at most the deployment's conflict report byte budget as JSON (LEDGER_LIMIT_MERGE_CONFLICT_REPORT_BYTES, default 2 MiB). Whole quads only. Diagnostic: the merged state, conflict_count and preview_token never depend on these limits (ADR-0024).

conflicts_truncated.description: The report limits (entry count or byte budget) left conflicts or quads out of `conflicts`. A side's own `truncated` flag also covers the 64-quad cap.

preview_token.description: Present exactly when a candidate would result (fast_forward / divergent).

Error.description: Error envelope. 503 is DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (database, key source or schema not usable), DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT (a database statement or lock wait exceeded its limit; the transaction was rolled back) or RESOURCE_LIMIT (HTTP time or concurrency limit); all three mean the outcome is unknown: retry with the same Idempotency-Key. 500 is INTERNAL with a generic message; the detail is logged under correlation_id.

get.summary: Readiness: required dependencies for the selected mode are usable

post.summary: Accept a prepared candidate onto a ref (review capability). With validation_id + semantic_environment_id the acceptance is bound to that conforming validation of this candidate run in that environment (VALIDATION_REJECTED, VALIDATION_STALE, VALIDATION_NOT_FOUND otherwise, nothing moves). Without them it fails with VALIDATION_REQUIRED unless the deployment explicitly allows unvalidated acceptance (development/CI only).

get.summary: Read a ref's head and version (read capability)
Reconstruct the state at a commit of this graph (read capability, bounded)

post.summary: Request a semantic validation of a prepared candidate (validate capability). The ledger reconstructs the candidate state, calls its configured validation service and records the immutable context and record. Never moves a ref.

get.summary: Read one validation record of a candidate (read capability). Another graph's, tenant's or candidate's record is VALIDATION_NOT_FOUND alike.

post.summary: Create a named branch at the source head or a commit reachable from it (propose capability; admin for a protected branch). No data is copied.

get.summary: A branch's status, head, version, policy and provenance (read capability)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Branch name (may contain `/`); never part of the path.

get.summary: A branch's lifecycle events (oldest first) and head movements (newest first) (read capability)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Branch name (may contain `/`); never part of the path.

get.summary: First-parent commit history from a branch head (read capability)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Branch name (may contain `/`); never part of the path.

post.summary: Delete (tombstone) a branch; head, version and history are kept (admin capability). `main` cannot be deleted.
Restore a deleted branch with the same head and version (admin capability).
Side-effect-free merge preview of `source` into `target` (read capability): classification, merge base, conflicts, merged-state digest and preview token (ADR-0024). Writes nothing.

Persist the integration candidate [target, source] of a still-current preview as a proposal on the target (propose capability; ADR-0023/0024). Refuses MERGE_STALE, MERGE_CONFLICT, MERGE_NOTHING_TO_DO, INVALID_MERGE_BASE.
Apply a merge proposal onto its target (review capability; the target's policy and the ADR-0019 validation binding apply). Any movement since the proposal is MERGE_STALE; nothing is recomputed.
